meta.title: Tower
meta.description: Mission planning, isolated worktrees, worker/reviewer agents, and review-gated merges.

tower.title: Tower host
tower.summary: Mission planning, worktree isolation, the mode guard, the health contract and the recovery escape.
tower.disables: Turns off the mandatory host; this equals uninstalling Tower: no tools, presets or skills remain.

tower-skills.title: Tower skills
tower-skills.summary: Playbooks for worker/reviewer agents and recovery after a blocked merge.
tower-skills.disables: The three Tower skills leave the catalog; the worker/reviewer protocol sections and every mission tool keep working.

tower-batch.title: Evidence batches
tower-batch.summary: Group missions into finite evidence batches and close them against required checks and receipts.
tower-batch.disables: tower_batch is not registered; missions, gates and merges are unaffected.

tower-import.title: Legacy import
tower-import.summary: Import a Tower Codex legacy state file and audit its snapshot-to-mission mapping.
tower-import.disables: tower_import_legacy and tower_legacy_map are not registered; new state is unaffected.

tower-leases.title: Advisory leases
tower-leases.summary: Coordinate heavy per-repository work with advisory resource leases.
tower-leases.disables: tower_resource is not registered; nothing else depends on a lease.

tower-tests.title: Test discovery
tower-tests.summary: Run the worktree's declared test discovery and record a receipt for the mission tip.
tower-tests.disables: tower_test is not registered and no receipt can be recorded; with gates.requireTests:true planning/mode entry is rejected with an explanation.

tower-hmr.title: Dev hot reload
tower-hmr.summary: Register tower_reload and /tower reload for linked-profile development.
tower-hmr.disables: tower_reload and /tower reload are unavailable; a non-HMR profile behaves exactly as before. Shipped off.

preset-tower-reviewer.title: Tower reviewer
preset-tower-reviewer.summary: Read-only independent review: inspect the mission diff, verify scope and acceptance, return a verdict.
preset-tower-reviewer.disables: The reviewer cannot be dispatched. Supported while review.requireReview is false; with the gate on planning/mode entry is locked with an explanatory error.
